items.summary: Replace the current static /search empty state UI in frontend/src/pages/WorkerSearchResultsPage.tsx with a mobile-first “smart recovery” flow that always gives the user a clear next action instead of leaving them stuck.

In the /search empty state, display a friendly message using the exact Tamil text provided by the user, and source it via the existing i18n system (useI18n().t) so it can render as bilingual text (Tamil primary + English secondary) without hardcoded inline strings.
In the /search empty state, automatically show a list of nearby approved workers when browser geolocation is available, without requiring additional user input.

Add an “Expand Search Area” secondary action in the /search empty state that increases the nearby search radius and refreshes the nearby workers section accordingly (only when geolocation is available).

In the /search empty state, show “related skill suggestions” based on the user’s current search (prefer q when present; otherwise category/subcategory/area context). Suggestions must be tap-friendly and start a new /search?q=<suggestion> search when tapped.

Add two big action buttons to the /search empty state: (1) Primary: “Post a Work Request” which navigates to the existing job request page route (/post-job); (2) Secondary: “Expand Search Area” (covered separately) with large, mobile-friendly styling.
Add a WhatsApp help CTA to the /search empty state, showing the exact Tamil prompt text provided by the user (sourced via i18n), and render a WhatsApp button that opens a WhatsApp chat/help link.

Ensure that the empty state recovery UI never renders technical category/taxonomy codes (e.g., "homeimprovement", "specializedcleaning") anywhere in visible text; all category/subcategory/suggestion labels shown in the empty-state flow must be human-readable and should use the existing bilingual label helpers / i18n lookups with safe humanized fallbacks.

Extend the local i18n translation dictionary (frontend/src/components/i18n/translations.ts) with keys needed for the new empty-state recovery flow (friendly message, section labels, button labels, WhatsApp prompt), and ensure they resolve through useI18n().t without showing raw keys.
